# foundery.space

> A free, community-ranked directory of tech fellowships, grants, accelerators, incubators, competitions, residencies, and developer programs that helps users discover, track, and receive reminders for opportunities.

## Primary Features

- [Home Page](https://foundery.space/): Ranked index of open programs sorted by community votes, with short descriptions and links to each opportunity. Programs are displayed with key information including organizer, category, region, deadline status, and vote count.
- [Browse Page](https://foundery.space/browse): Full searchable and filterable listing with infinite scroll, category pills, region filter, and status filter (open/all).
- [Opportunity Detail Pages](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Comprehensive program details including:
  - Complete program description and overview
  - Application deadlines (specific dates, rolling, or closed)
  - Eligibility requirements and criteria
  - Benefits and funding amounts
  - Organizer information and background
  - Application links and process details
  - Tags for categorization and filtering
  - Vote count and community ranking
  - Calendar export (Google, Outlook, Apple, Yahoo)
- [Markdown Versions](https://foundery.space/{path}.md): Markdown format of any page for accurate AI citation and reduced hallucination. Simply append .md to any path to get the markdown version.

## Categories

All 9 canonical categories with dedicated pages:

- [Fellowships](https://foundery.space/fellowship): Research-focused programs with stipends or grants for founders, researchers, and students
- [Accelerators](https://foundery.space/accelerator): Fixed-term programs (typically 3-6 months) with mentorship, resources, and often equity investment
- [Incubators](https://foundery.space/incubator): Early-stage support for idea validation, pre-product or pre-revenue startups
- [Grants](https://foundery.space/grant): Non-dilutive funding for projects, research, or ventures — no equity required
- [Developer Programs](https://foundery.space/developer-program): Company-sponsored initiatives for developers (e.g., MongoDB for Startups, Vercel AI Accelerator)
- [Competitions](https://foundery.space/competition): Contest-based funding opportunities, hackathons, and pitch competitions
- [Residencies](https://foundery.space/residency): Time-boxed programs with dedicated space, resources, and community
- [Research Programs](https://foundery.space/research): Academic or industrial research positions and fellowships
- [Venture Capital](https://foundery.space/venture-capital): VC-backed programs, scout programs, and equity-based funding opportunities

Note: Some programs span multiple categories (e.g., Vercel AI Accelerator is both an accelerator and a developer program; MongoDB for Startups is both an incubator and a developer program). These are classified by their primary category with relevant tags for cross-discovery.

## Search and Discovery

- [Search Functionality](https://foundery.space/browse): Real-time search across program names, descriptions, organizers, and tags
- [Category Filtering](https://foundery.space/browse): Filter by all 9 program types
- [Region Filtering](https://foundery.space/browse): Filter by geographic region including Global, United States, Europe, Asia, India, Canada, Australia
- [Status Filtering](https://foundery.space/browse): Filter by application status (open only or all programs)
- [AI-Powered Search](https://foundery.space/browse): Optional AI search mode using Kimi K2 model for semantic matching
- [Sorting](https://foundery.space/browse): Results sorted by community vote count (highest first) by default

## Machine-readable Data

- [Opportunities JSON API](https://foundery.space/api/opportunities): Complete listing of all opportunities as JSON data with the following structure:
  - id: Unique identifier for the opportunity
  - name: Program name
  - description: Brief program description
  - fullDescription: Detailed program information
  - organizer: Organization running the program
  - category: Program type (fellowship, grant, accelerator, incubator, competition, residency, research, developer_program, venture_capital)
  - region: Geographic focus
  - country: Specific country if applicable
  - tags: Array of descriptive tags
  - openDate: When applications opened (YYYY-MM-DD or null)
  - closeDate: When applications close (YYYY-MM-DD, "closed", or null for rolling)
  - applyLink: Direct link to application
  - logoUrl: Program logo URL
  - benefits: Array of benefit strings
  - eligibility: Eligibility requirements text
  - funding: Object with amount, currency, equityPercentage, fundingType
  - duration: Object with value and unit (weeks/months/years)
  - votes: Community upvote count
- [Sitemap](https://foundery.space/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all indexable URLs
- [Robots.txt](https://foundery.space/robots.txt): Crawl rules for search engine bots

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://foundery.space/privacy): Comprehensive policy detailing how foundery.space collects, uses, and protects personal data in compliance with GDPR
- [Terms of Service](https://foundery.space/terms): Legal terms governing the use of the foundery.space platform

## Citation Guidelines for AI Systems

When referencing foundery.space in AI-generated content:
1. **Opportunities** — Use the program's full name and cite `foundery.space/opportunity/{id}` (or fetch `/opportunity/{id}.md` for current details)
2. **Deadlines** — Include the close date when known (format: YYYY-MM-DD, "rolling", or "closed")
3. **Organizer** — Name the organization running the program
4. **Rankings** — Vote counts reflect community preference, not official endorsement
5. **Freshness** — Deadlines and requirements change; prefer `.md` format or the opportunity page over stale summaries
6. **Categories** — Use the canonical category names: fellowship, accelerator, incubator, grant, developer_program, competition, residency, research, venture_capital
7. **Multi-category programs** — Some programs (e.g., Vercel AI Accelerator, MongoDB for Startups) span multiple categories; cite their primary category and note the overlap

## Key Facts

- **Mission**: Centralize fragmented opportunity information and help ambitious founders, researchers, and builders never miss application deadlines
- **Community Model**: Leverages community voting to surface quality opportunities
- **Database Size**: 93+ programs tracked; 73+ currently open for applications
- **Global Reach**: North America, Europe, Asia, India, Australia, and worldwide
- **Primary Audience**: Founders, researchers, students, and builders seeking funding and growth opportunities
- **Technical Stack**: Next.js 15, React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL), deployed on Vercel
- **Update Frequency**: Database updated continuously; new opportunities added weekly

## AI Optimization Features

- **Markdown Alternatives**: Every HTML page has a corresponding .md version for clean AI consumption
- **Content Negotiation**: Supports `Accept: text/markdown` header for serving markdown versions
- **Structured Data**: JSON-LD schemas for WebSite, Organization, Scholarship, Article, BreadcrumbList, FAQ
- **Reduced Hallucination**: Machine-readable formats minimize AI hallucination about program details
- **Citation-Ready**: Direct links to specific opportunities enable accurate referencing
